description: Canonical world validation rules. This is the SAME file server/assetd loads. The SDK validator and the server validator MUST read this exact file so a world that passes locally passes on upload. Two copies of the allowlist would drift and the server's copy is the one that matters for security.

shaders.note: Custom .gdshader files are gated by trust level. Level ≥5 (Creator) can attach custom shaders; below that, only allowlisted parameterized built-in materials are permitted. The validator checks the author's trust level at upload time and strips shaders below the threshold.

scripting.note: All behaviour must come from SerikaScript (sandboxed VM). Any embedded GDScript/C#/GDExtension is stripped at build time and fails validation here so the creator finds out locally, not on upload.

trust_level_gates.description: Features gated by the author's trust level (0=Visitor ... 8=Verified Creator). The server checks the author's trust at upload time; the client checks again at load time. Both MUST agree.

gates.description: Attach custom .gdshader files to materials. Below this level, only built-in StandardMaterial3D / ORMMaterial3D are allowed.
GPUParticles3D and CPUParticles3D with custom emission scripts. Below this level, particles are allowed but without SerikaScript-driven emission.
SerikaAudioZone with SerikaScript-driven spatial playback control.
SerikaScript NetEmitString, NetSyncGet, NetSyncSet host calls. Below this level, only numeric NetEmit is available.
Allow users to spawn invite portals in this world. World must also set allow_invite_portals=true in its manifest.
SerikaVideoPlayer nodes. Below this level, video screens are display-only (thumbnail).
